title: Averaging over a replaced marginal
statement: Let $D$ be a finite label set, let $V$ be a set of variables, and let a constraint satisfaction instance on $V$ have a nonempty multiset of constraints in which every variable occurs. For any family of probability laws on $D$ indexed by $V$ and any variable $v$, replacing the law at $v$ by the point mass at a label drawn from its original law leaves the instance's expected fraction of satisfied constraints unchanged on average.
hypotheses_covered: Every declared variable occurs in some constraint scope
A probability law on labels for each variable
